turns.shown:
Street address of Union Station, Washington, DC — Answered.
Union Station is at 50 Massachusetts Avenue NE, Washington, DC 20002. Amtrak's station page gives the same street address with the longer ZIP+4 code 20002-4214 (the cited sources do not show: 4). The pages I found don't state a date for the address. An address like this rarely changes. [1] [2]

What I couldn't establish
- Date of the address — the pages I found show no date for the address itself. I searched once, and the station operator's and Amtrak's pages agreed.

Sources
[1] Contact Us — https://www.unionstationdc.com/contact-us/ (search result age: 168 days ago)
[2] Washington, DC - Union Station (WAS) — https://www.amtrak.com/stations/was (search result age: 285 days ago)
